zoom.description: The most widely used video-conferencing program. It's the default choice for most regular classes.
install_steps: Go to zoom.us/download and download the 'Zoom Workplace desktop app.'
Run the downloaded installer to complete installation.
You can join a class without creating an account (signing in is optional).
Before class, check the join link or meeting ID your teacher has shared with you.
join_steps: 5 minutes before class starts, click the join link your teacher sent you.
The Zoom app will open automatically; if it's not installed yet, follow the prompt to install it first.
When asked for camera and microphone access, select 'Allow.'
Select 'Join with Computer Audio' and you're ready for class.

voov.description: A video-conferencing program that connects reliably in China and other regions with limited access. It's the international version of Tencent Meeting.
install_steps: Go to voovmeeting.com/download-center.html and download the version for your device.
Run the downloaded installer to complete installation.
Open the app (you can also 'Join as Guest' without signing up).
Before class, check the meeting ID or join link your teacher has shared with you.
join_steps: 5 minutes before class starts, click the join link your teacher sent you, or tap 'Join' in the app.
Enter the meeting ID provided (this fills in automatically if you use the link).
When asked for camera and microphone access, select 'Allow.'
Enter your name and join — you're ready for class.

teams.description: A video-conferencing program used as needed, for example by institutional or corporate members.
install_steps: Go to microsoft.com/microsoft-teams/download-app and download the app.
Run the downloaded installer to complete installation.
Sign in with a Microsoft account, or select 'Continue as guest' when joining via a link.
Before class, check the Teams meeting link your teacher has shared with you.
join_steps: 5 minutes before class starts, click the Teams meeting link your teacher sent you.
Choose either 'Open Teams app' or 'Continue on this browser.'
When asked for camera and microphone access, select 'Allow.'
Click 'Join now' and you're ready for class.
